deliverables: Open, standardized interface across Cardano on-chain protocols
Documentation, auto-generated multi-language SDKs, and live JSON-RPC endpoints from verified interface definitions
Agent-first documentation, protocol skills packaging operations, and an MCP server for agent discovery and calls
Onboarding of 12 additional protocols over 12 months, three per quarter, with developer and agent coverage
request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of TxPipe.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Tx3 by TxPipe as an open API layer for Cardano dApp protocols.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,308,000 ADA plus a 327,000 ADA contingency reserve over 12 months, with a total withdrawal of 1,684,050 ADA including a 49,050 ADA Intersect administration fee.
Tx3 is intended to provide a standard open-source interface to Cardano protocols through documentation, multi-language SDKs, and live RPC endpoints.
The proposal says there is currently no common interface mechanism across the Cardano ecosystem, causing each integrator to relearn each protocol and making cross-protocol composability impractical.
Through Catalyst Fund 14, TxPipe has already put the developer layer into production with five protocols live on the Tx3 Protocol Registry.
The proposal funds 12 additional protocol onboardings, three per quarter, plus development of the MCP server and skill framework as shared registry infrastructure.
The proposal claims it aligns with Intersect strategic Pillar 2 by improving developer experience and with Pillar 4 by supporting ecosystem growth and market adoption.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain submission.
The requested amount is claimed not to breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission.
TxPipe is said to have received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals across Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and four under development and on schedule.

Intersect says treasury funds will be administered through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with Intersect admin and leadership roles, an external Oversight Committee, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls.

summary: The document describes a 1,684,050 ADA treasury withdrawal submitted by Intersect on behalf of TxPipe to expand Tx3 into a standardized developer and AI-agent interface layer for Cardano protocols, with claimed Intersect process approval, NCL compliance, smart-contract fund controls, and milestone oversight.
